The scheduler is idle 79.3% of cycles because there are too few warps per scheduler (0.93 eligible vs 10.54 active). The workload is a simple strided scatter/copy. The fix is a persistent kernel: launch exactly num_SMs CTAs, each processing multiple tiles in a loop. This keeps all SMs busy for the full duration and amortizes kernel launch overhead. Increasing XBLOCK from 128 to 1024 simultaneously reduces the grid from 1960 to 245 CTAs while processing 8x more elements per CTA, improving warp-level parallelism within each block.
